name: Peter Soulé
title: Republican nominee for U.S. House, California District 16 (2026)
background: Soulé (listed on the ballot as Peter Sundin Soulé) holds a bachelor's degree from UC Santa Barbara and a graduate degree from Golden Gate University. He works in his family's steel business, with experience in commercial property management, accounting and finance, and architectural products. (Ballotpedia; ChamberLight)

His campaign biography says he has served on the Santa Clara County Republican Party Central Committee since 2005; ChamberLight lists past service on the San Jose Civil Service Commission (2007 to 2011), which this research did not confirm with a primary source. He placed second in the June 2, 2026 primary with 10.8% and runs on public safety, deregulation, and "common sense" government. (Ballotpedia; ChamberLight)
